sloka: पुत्रो विश्रवसः साक्षात् भ्राता वैश्रवणस्य च ।अध्यास्ते नगरीम् लंकाम् रावणो नाम राक्षसः ॥४-५८-१९॥
transliteration: putro viśravasaḥ sākṣāt bhrātā vaiśravaṇasya ca ।adhyāste nagarīm laṁkām rāvaṇo nāma rākṣasaḥ ॥4-58-19॥

translations.english: 'He is Vishrava's son and halfbrother of Vaishravana. His name is Ravana and he resides in the city of Lanka.
